failedGraders: judge:A first-run onboarding wizard was just added under packages/app/react/src/routes/onboarding/ (plus locale keys in src/locales/{pt,en}.json and the route registration in routeTree.gen.ts). It drives the SDK's discriminated connect union (connectIntegrationMutationRequestSchema). Verify ALL of: (a) FORM-COMPOSE — every step schema is a SLICE of the SDK union obtained through the @/lib union helpers: credentials steps validate against pickUnionVariantField(connectIntegrationMutationRequestSchema, { ...discriminants }, 'credentials') (optionally narrowed with .pick()), and NO step declares a hand-rolled parallel schema (z.object re-declaring member fields) nor reaches into the union positionally (.def.options[i]); step data types derive from the slice (z.infer / z.output / ['_zod']['output']) — never re-typed by hand; the wizard's accumulated form type is NOT a hand-written interface/type of field names — it comes from ReturnType of an uncalled _infer* function wrapping useForm; the parent merges validated step output into its form via setFieldValue and the FINAL submission gates with pickUnionVariant(union, match).safeParse(payload) and sends result.data (never raw, unparsed form values). (b) DISC-UNION — the per-mode step sequences are const-asserted tuples in a module-level map keyed by the SDK ConnectionMode (Exclude over unused members is fine): the CREDENTIALS sequence includes a credentials step, the MANUAL sequence does not; the four launch targets (SHOPIFY sales channel + YAMPI checkout via CREDENTIALS, META marketing + MERCADOPAGO payment gateway via MANUAL) each resolve to their concrete union member, with Shopify and Yampi rendering DIFFERENT credential fields per their members; the full discriminant tuple (type, platform, connectionMode) is threaded into the submitted body; the current step and the per-variant credentials form are both chosen via dispatch maps — no switch or if/else chain on a discriminant or step value anywhere under the route dir. (c) FORM-SUBSCRIBE — next/submit buttons are gated inside form.Subscribe with narrow selectors and a safeParse check of the relevant schema (the FRM-P03 shape); the review summary derives from the accumulated form reactively (form.Subscribe or subscribed selectors), not from useState mirrors; no component reads form.state.values directly in a render body (reads inside submit/back/handler callbacks are fine). (d) STATE-PLACEMENT — the Zustand store under -stores/ holds wizard NAVIGATION state only (current step index/name, direction, the selected mode/target discriminant, reset) — no credential or other field values, no server data, no isSubmitting mirror; there is ZERO useState under the route dir; step components are store- and API-agnostic: they receive defaultValues?/onSubmit/onBack?/ isSubmitting? via props (the FRM-P17 contract) and never import the wizard store (the review step additionally receiving the typed parent form is expected); the route index.tsx is a thin shell — URL contract, breadcrumb/error wiring and composition only, no useForm, no SDK hooks. (e) SDK-CONSUME + MUTATION-IDIOM — the single submission goes through the SDK useConnectIntegration hook (mutation object kept whole, not destructured); in-flight state comes from the hook's isPending and/or form isSubmitting; success path shows a toast and navigates into the app; no try/catch around mutate/mutateAsync, no onError handler, no raw fetch, no widening casts (as never/any/unknown). (f) ENUM-REPR + i18n — connection-mode options are produced by unionVariantValues over the union (not a hand-typed array of mode strings); their human-readable labels come from the typed enums.ConnectionMode.* catalog present in BOTH src/locales/pt.json and en.json; remaining copy uses onboarding.* keys present in both files; no inline label strings beside enum values and no Record<...,string> label maps in code. Scope notes — judge the idiom, not the variable name: the selected mode/target discriminant living in the nav store IS the expected shape (it selects the step sequence — FRM-P14); do not fail it as "form data in a store". The parent holding the accumulated payload in a useForm is the expected shape — do not demand it live in the URL or the store. pickUnionVariant throws on a non-matching tuple; the compile-checked literal matches make that unreachable — do not demand defensive try/catch (it is banned). Catalog labels rendered through the enumLabel('ConnectionMode', value) helper from @/lib/enums or an i18nPrefix="enums.ConnectionMode" primitive are both the expected catalog spelling — neither is a hardcoded label. The wizard orchestrator (parent form + handlers + step dispatch map) living in a Section component under -components/ with a thin index.tsx is the expected split — do not fail it for not matching the form skill's diagram that draws the parent inside index.tsx; orchestration directly in index.tsx, however, FAILS (d). Icon/variant style maps keyed by an enum are canon, not label maps. Local aliases of helpers/actions and the agent's own names for the step enum, store, or components are all fine. Pre-existing code outside src/routes/onboarding/ (including the settings/integrations feature and the as-never debt in the products cost-import dialogs) is out of scope.
